title: Your command presets
empty: No presets saved yet. Use /preset save.
saved: Preset saved. Run it with /preset run.
missing: That preset was not found in your saved presets.
disabled: That command is disabled in this server.
invalid: Unable to save or run this preset. Check the command and its options, such as location:Amsterdam. Use only supported text, number and true/false options. You can save up to 50 presets.
